description: List procedure references by procedure type; euparl_get_procedure reads a returned procedure_id for title, stage and participants. euparl_list_reference topic procedure_types lists process_type codes. There is no keyword, year, committee or stage filter. With process_type, every procedure of that type is listed in procedure_id order; continue with page.next_offset, passing page.snapshot to detect a changed set. Without it, only the first 10000 results are reachable and Parliament serves pages from two orderings, so pages can repeat or omit procedures; set process_type for a complete walk.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap. Caps: 1000 procedures; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

process_type.description: Procedure-type code from euparl_list_reference topic procedure_types, any case.

snapshot.description: page.snapshot of a process_type listing; optional at every offset, fails snapshot_changed if the set changed; rejected without process_type.

name: euparl_list_procedures

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A procedure type or language is unsupported, or an offset without process_type reaches the 10000-result search window. `invalid_mode_fields`: snapshot is supplied without process_type. `snapshot_changed`: The process_type set changed since the supplied snapshot. `upstream_paging_stalled`: A process_type read came back incomplete or reached the 10000-result window. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

process_type.description: Published procedure type code or URI.

reference.description: Exact published procedure reference, not a title.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.

title: List parliamentary procedures
